title: Yoisaki Kanade — She Who Brings Me Warmth〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... It was somewhere around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is☆
Kanade, Mizuki, over here♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, this is the bouquet workshop...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It doesn't look too crowded right now.
You might actually be able to make a bouquet for Honami while she shops for souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Otori, Mizuki, thank you both for helping me out like this so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is there anything you wanna get, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, would you mind if I asked you two for a favor first...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to thank Ms. Mochizuki somehow for inviting us out today and for everything she helps me with. Do you have any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is that what you meant by a favor?
Hmm... Flowers are the first thing that comes to mind for me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, there's this place where you can make a bouquet!
They have staff there to help, so anyone can do it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's perfect!
And it totally goes with the bridal fair theme!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it does...
Then, I think I'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't mention it!
More importantly, you should probably go register now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, please choose whichever flowers you'd like to use from here.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: You may also refer to this sheet if you'd like to know their names as well as what they symbolize.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! These flowers are all so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it's pretty cool that they let you know what each flower symbolizes! So, Kanade, which do you wanna use?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well... Forget-me-nots apparently symbolize “true love”, while pink gladioli symbolize “earnest love”...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess it makes sense that a lot of these focus on love since it is a wedding bouquet. Oh, these flowers seem to be about appreciation!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Let's see what they have...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, these...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you find some that you like?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it says that these white dahlias symbolize “appreciation” and “abundant love”.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki brings over dahlias from time to time, so I thought she'd like seeing some familiar flowers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's really nice♪ Also, “abundant love” goes really well with Honami's personality!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was also thinking about using these bluestars since they look so pretty...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... They symbolize “love and happiness”, and “believing in one another”!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's perfect!
You did just give each other your vows earlier today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Do you take one another as wedded spouses for better, for worse, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish from this day forth?”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Kanade, what else do you wanna use?
There's still lots more flowers to choose from☆

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure. I don't know which to choose... Actually, could I ask you two for some recommendations?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Then, as your cupids, we shall lovingly bestow our advice upon you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, we shall.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, you've got your flowers!
Now you just gotta put your bouquet together♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, the dahlias are gonna take center stage?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, followed by the bluestars.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... How about some roses for a little more color?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
So... L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! The dahlias turned the other way!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? I thought I had a good grip on them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here, I'll hold the stems.
They shouldn't turn or anything if I can keep them steady like this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, Kanade, I'll hand you the flowers♪
Which do you want next?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much...
Next, I think...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want them to face forward more, like this... And there's a gap here that I'll need to fill.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope Ms. Mochizuki likes this...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. The corner for the bouquet exhibit's supposed to be around here somewhere. I was hoping to take a look at it, so would it be okay if we went there next?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It must be all the fresh-cut flowers.
The roses, the lilies of the valley... So many gentle fragrances all mixing together. It's very soothing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely! And there aren't that many people here, probably since this exhibit's way in the back. We can relax here for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What did you think, Kanade?!
Did you enjoy our special show?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Ms. Mochizuki's such a nice person...
She's so considerate that she's probably been worrying about me, even when I'm not around.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Including how she invited me out for today's fair...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is so strange... On the surface, I feel sorry for causing her so much trouble. But deep down, I feel this warmth beginning to well up...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's all the more reason for me to show her my appreciation.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
All good!
Honami hasn't returned yet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
All that's left is for you to give her the bouquet you made♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She'll be coming over to my house after this, so I'll try to give these to her at the right time there.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki, Otori, thank you both very much for helping me. I was able to make a very nice bouquet for her as a result.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope Honami really likes it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to giving this to her.
